need: Publish a verifiable GitHub release whose artifacts, dependencies, checksums, and provenance match the built wheel.

discovery.stop_condition: Two established SBOM contenders and the native host release/provenance path identified.

contenders.name: CycloneDX Python
evidence: clean wheel environment: root plus 14 dependency components covered all 15 installed distributions
reproducible mode emitted no timestamp, random serial, or environment path

contenders.name: Syft
evidence: default scan emitted 48 components including 33 file records and 34 temporary-environment path references
Python-only scan with file catalogers disabled covered 15 distributions but duplicated the root, emitted only 7 dependency nodes, typed the root as file, and retained a random serial and timestamp

contenders.name: extra release/signing service
evidence: no surviving gap before the native path is measured

unknowns: GitHub-hosted artifact attestation remains unverified until the annotated tag triggers the release workflow.
decision_effect: Generate one reproducible CycloneDX 1.6 SBOM from the clean installed wheel environment; keep Syft out of the release chain; release only through GitHub.
reconsider_when: Neither SBOM describes the clean wheel environment accurately
